title: Which of an English mental health trust's eleven community mental health teams get a 2027-28 DBT skills group, on each team's share of its 2026 assessed patients whose emotional instability reaches the collaborative's standard as the collaborative's three-hourly app will measure it
subdomain: experience-sampling-intensive-longitudinal-analysis (an English mental health trust's 2027-28 DBT skills groups, each community team's share of its 2026 assessed patients with high emotional instability as a provider collaborative's three-hourly mood app will measure it, read from the trust's own mood app ratings)
